treatment: same cost objective and selection with four added baseline-score features; dimension 16
features: top20 mean of scores divided by maximum score
top20 population standard deviation of scores divided by maximum score
top20 fraction of total score belonging to first candidate
top20 last score divided by first score
feature_contract: n=min(20,candidate count), zero vector if maximum zero; operate on existing baseline ranking only, no auxiliary outcome, gold target or repository identity; use score/top ratios to avoid overflow; fixed array output; no allocation
fit: FP32 weighted BCE; learning_rate .1, l2 .0001, epochs 100, batch 64; same fitter and validation epoch selection as 20
folds: unchanged test i/train i+1/validation i+2 over etcd, test-infra, lxd
selection: same validation-only 90% budget threshold then penalty selection as 20; no held-out selection
primary: 16-feature cost_selected seed 1729; seed 2718 independent initialization check, not independent data
gate: unchanged 20/15 gate; pages<=always-helper, calls<=90%, Recall1/10>=raw and learned policies Pareto dominate gap in pages/calls with at least one strict gain
resources: measure additive feature extraction allocations/time on synthetic rankings; full training/evaluation process RSS and wall separately; no LLM cost conversion
replay: all 30 treatment heads/report byte-identical; old 30 control heads/report byte-identical to verified 20 archive
independence: exploratory existing 2948 docstring queries; no claim of fresh final evidence or CoSQA reserve use
